Dear Fabien Ferreira,
Thank you for bringing this to our attention.
If there is visible fusion residue on one of the pins of Outlet 1, we recommend discontinuing use of the connector until it has been inspected and cleaned or replaced. Continued use may pose a risk to equipment or safety.
We have escalated the issue to our regional team,they will reach out to you shortly to provide further details and coordinate the next steps.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -Ankita

Dear Colleagues,
We’ve received a report indicating fusion residue on one of the pins of the charging connector at Outlet 1. Kindly arrange for a physical inspection at the earliest to assess the condition.
Please take all necessary steps to ensure safety, including cleaning, disabling, or replacing the connector if required. Your assessment and recommendations will help determine whether the outlet can continue to be used safely.
